description: This React component file defines the TenantBootstrapGate component which ensures that the TenantBootstrap logic executes before rendering any nested routes. It acts as a route guard by wrapping protected routes and rendering an Outlet for nested content.

methods.name: TenantBootstrapGate()
methods.description: React functional component that renders TenantBootstrap and an Outlet to ensure tenant bootstrap logic executes before rendering nested routes.
